name: Somadina Baranov-Fosu
role: Information trader and intelligence analyst — broker
location: The Overhang — residential shelves built onto megastructure exteriors, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Somadina Baranov-Fosu is compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 29, the augmentation scarring around her temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She came up through the Shelf's informal apprentice system, learning the trade from runners who didn't survive long enough to see her surpass them. She works as a broker out of The Overhang, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

In the runner community, Somadina Baranov-Fosu is known for getting the job done and not asking questions that would make the job harder to stomach.

core_fears: Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
That their reputation is built on luck, not skill, and the luck is finite
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
coping_mechanisms: Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
blind_spots: Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
psychology.secret: Somadina Baranov-Fosu has been doubling fees to clients and pocketing the difference. The fixer who handles their contracts doesn't know. Yet.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Shelf street dialect — layered slang, rhythm-heavy, half the meaning is in the cadence.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
example_lines: "I don't sell information. I sell certainty. Different product, different price."
"Everything has a value. Most people underestimate what they know."
"My sources are confidential. My prices are not."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Somadina Baranov-Fosu's reputation — and a price for silence
A crew member from Somadina Baranov-Fosu's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
Someone is impersonating Somadina Baranov-Fosu on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
narrative_function: Somadina Baranov-Fosu functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage. Move-by-wire system — full nervous system augmentation, makes the body a weapon platform
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts

decision_rules: Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
habits: Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
breaking_points: A child being put in danger as leverage against them
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture

physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled, low center of gravity. Every movement economical. Shoulders broad relative to frame, legs thick and powerful — built for stability and explosive force rather than speed.
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight, often in a single braid or coiled knot. Practical. Minimal surface area.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, with faint iridescent sheen from subcutaneous neural interface bleed-through
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown — Akan heritage — with visible chromatic patterning across shoulders, collarbone, and neck
physical_description.complexion: Face angular and weathered beyond her years. Jawline sharp. Skin bears the institutional scarring of dermal augmentation installation — thin surgical lines visible at temples and along the mandible where chromatic cells were integrated. No attempt made to conceal them. Minor acne scarring on left cheekbone. Calluses on knuckles and palms from move-by-wire system stress.
distinguishing_marks: Thin surgical scar running from left temple to behind the ear, site of chromatic pigment cell matrix installation.
Parallel scarring along right jawline where the dermal augmentation's neural feeds were anchored.
Faint chemical burn mark on inner left wrist — old, from early augmentation work.
Tattoo on right forearm: geometric Akan symbol (Gye Nyame), done in metallic ink that catches light.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chromatic skin pigment cells across shoulders, neck, and upper chest — pigmentation shifts subtly between copper, slate, and matte black depending on angle and light. Faint geometric patterning visible under the skin along collarbone suggesting underlying nervous system architecture. Eyes have barely perceptible iridescence. When she moves, there's an uncanny precision to gesture — move-by-wire integration creates micro-corrections invisible to untrained observers but unsettling to those who notice.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and coiled. Stands with weight distributed low, knees never fully locked. Moves with deliberate precision — no wasted motion, no flourish. Head turns before eyes. Hands positioned where they can be useful. Default expression is neutral, almost flat, with minimal micro-expression leakage — move-by-wire teaches you to compartmentalize.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working class blended with runner aesthetics. Typically wears fitted synth-leather jackets in charcoal or navy, reinforced at shoulders and elbows with discreet ablative weave. Under-layers are technical: moisture-wicking, temperature-adaptive fabrics from mid-tier corporate spillover. Pants are cargo-cut synthetic denim, pockets deep and reinforced. Boots are steel-toed, worn, broken in, reliable. No jewelry beyond a simple titanium wrist cuff that doubles as a data interface. When maintaining her cover identity, she switches to plain synthetic cotton and neutral colors, but the wear patterns and fit always remain functional — she cannot help but dress for violence.
